            for (int i = 0; i < obj.Measurements.Count; i++)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteDouble(ref data, (double)(obj.Measurements[i]));
            }
        }
        if (obj.Flags is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(obj.Flags.Count));
            for (int i = 0; i < obj.Flags.Count; i++)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteBoolean(ref data, (bool)(obj.Flags[i]));
            }
        }
        if (obj.ObservableData is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(obj.ObservableData.Count));
            for (int i = 0; i < obj.ObservableData.Count; i++)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt16(ref data, (short)(obj.ObservableData[i]));
            }
        }
        if (obj.Characters is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(obj.Characters.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.Characters)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(ref data, (ushort)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.SortedValues is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(obj.SortedValues.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.SortedValues)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt64(ref data, (long)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.SmallSet is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteByte(ref data, (byte)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteByte(ref data, checked((byte)(obj.SmallSet.Count)));
            foreach (var item in obj.SmallSet)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteString(ref data, item);
            }
        }
        if (obj.MediumQueue is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(ref data, (ushort)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(ref data, checked((ushort)(obj.MediumQueue.Count)));
            foreach (var item in obj.MediumQueue)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.LargeBag is null)
        {
            throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(obj.LargeBag), "Fixed-size collections cannot be null.");
        }
        if (obj.LargeBag.Count != 8)
        {
            throw new System.InvalidOperationException($"Collection 'LargeBag' must have a size of 8 but was {obj.LargeBag.Count}.");
        }
        foreach (var item in obj.LargeBag)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt64(ref data, (long)(item));
        }
    }

    public static void Serialize(EnumerationTypesPacket obj, System.Span<byte> data)
    {
        Serialize(obj, ref data);
    }

    public static void Serialize(EnumerationTypesPacket obj, System.IO.Stream stream)
    {
        if (obj is null)
        {
            throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(obj));
        }
        if (obj.Numbers is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Numbers.Count));
            if (global::System.BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
            {
                var collectionBytes = System.Runtime.InteropServices.MemoryMarshal.AsBytes(System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(obj.Numbers));
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(stream, collectionBytes);
            }
            else
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(obj.Numbers).Length; i++)
                {
                    global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(obj.Numbers)[i]));
                }
            }
        }
        if (obj.Names is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Names.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.Names)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteString(stream, item);
            }
        }
        if (obj.Data is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            if (obj.Data is System.Collections.Generic.ICollection<byte> dataCollection)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(dataCollection.Count));
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(stream, dataCollection);
            }
            else if (obj.Data is System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyCollection<byte> dataReadOnlyCollection)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(dataReadOnlyCollection.Count));
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(stream, dataReadOnlyCollection);
            }
            else
            {
                var dataSequence = global::System.Linq.Enumerable.ToArray(obj.Data);
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(dataSequence.Length));
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(stream, dataSequence);
            }
        }
        if (obj.Data1 is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Data1.Count));
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(stream, System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(obj.Data1));
        }
        if (obj.Values is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Values.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.Values)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteSingle(stream, (float)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.UniqueIds is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.UniqueIds.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.UniqueIds)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt64(stream, (long)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.ProcessingQueue is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.ProcessingQueue.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.ProcessingQueue)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(stream, (ushort)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.ProcessingStack is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.ProcessingStack.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.ProcessingStack)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteUInt32(stream, (uint)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.ArrayData is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.ArrayData.Length));
            if (global::System.BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
            {
                var collectionBytes = System.Runtime.InteropServices.MemoryMarshal.AsBytes(obj.ArrayData.AsSpan());
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(stream, collectionBytes);
            }
            else
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < obj.ArrayData.AsSpan().Length; i++)
                {
                    global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.ArrayData.AsSpan()[i]));
                }
            }
        }
        if (obj.Measurements is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Measurements.Count));
            for (int i = 0; i < obj.Measurements.Count; i++)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteDouble(stream, (double)(obj.Measurements[i]));
            }
        }
        if (obj.Flags is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Flags.Count));
            for (int i = 0; i < obj.Flags.Count; i++)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteBoolean(stream, (bool)(obj.Flags[i]));
            }
        }
        if (obj.ObservableData is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.ObservableData.Count));
            for (int i = 0; i < obj.ObservableData.Count; i++)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt16(stream, (short)(obj.ObservableData[i]));
            }
        }
        if (obj.Characters is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.Characters.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.Characters)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(stream, (ushort)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.SortedValues is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(obj.SortedValues.Count));
            foreach (var item in obj.SortedValues)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt64(stream, (long)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.SmallSet is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteByte(stream, (byte)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteByte(stream, checked((byte)(obj.SmallSet.Count)));
            foreach (var item in obj.SmallSet)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteString(stream, item);
            }
        }
        if (obj.MediumQueue is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(stream, (ushort)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteUInt16(stream, checked((ushort)(obj.MediumQueue.Count)));
            foreach (var item in obj.MediumQueue)
            {
                global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(stream, (int)(item));
            }
        }
        if (obj.LargeBag is null)
        {
            throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(obj.LargeBag), "Fixed-size collections cannot be null.");
        }
        if (obj.LargeBag.Count != 8)
        {
            throw new System.InvalidOperationException($"Collection 'LargeBag' must have a size of 8 but was {obj.LargeBag.Count}.");
        }
        foreach (var item in obj.LargeBag)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.StreamWriterHelpers.WriteInt64(stream, (long)(item));
        }
    }
}
